en: Black‑and‑white view of an old European street corner focused on an ornate exterior stairway leading to a doorway with a domed canopy. The stair balustrade is decorated with sculpted reliefs and crests, and an elaborate wrought‑iron gate stands to the left. The wall surfaces are worn, with windows protected by heavy iron grilles. A street sign reading "Neumarkt." is fixed to the corner of the building. To the right stands a townhouse with shopfronts; a hanging sign advertises "Uhren & Goldwaren". A small archway and a cart covered with cloth are visible under the main building, suggesting an early 20th‑century urban scene.
